scientific_integrity: The numerical checks cover ten finite cases only; the all-parameter statement is proved by a join-and-pushout argument. Distances and the face decomposition are verified independently; no external audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts only. Homotopy splitting not asserted equivariant. For two parts no full degree-one integral representation is claimed; literature priority is not independently certified.
title: Integral homotopy and symmetry of multipartite geodesic general-position complexes
